product_overview: VitalsSniper is a Chrome extension popup dashboard for auditing website performance and generating client outreach materials. It helps users inspect Core Web Vitals, compare competitors, manage saved leads, and configure agency branding from a single interface.
core_goals: Inspect a target website for Core Web Vitals, DOM bloat, and LCP attribution details.
Generate outreach scripts for pitching web performance services across multiple channels and tones.
Save prospects to a local lead pipeline and export the list as CSV.
Compare a target website against a competitor URL to review relative performance.
Activate Pro access and sync cloud vault data using a license or API key.
Configure agency white-label branding details for personalized reporting.

features.name: Core Web Vitals and DOM Diagnostics
features.description: Allows users to audit a target website and review performance, DOM, and technical stack telemetry in the popup.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Enter a target URL -> Run a manual audit -> See health score, telemetry cards, LCP breakdown, DOM counts, and tech stack details
Navigate to /popup.html -> Use the active target site context -> Run a manual audit -> Review Core Web Vitals diagnostics and element-level attribution details

features.name: Outreach Script Generator
features.description: Generates client pitch scripts for different outreach channels and tones, then lets users copy the result.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the outreach generator -> Switch to Email, Merchant Pitch, Agency Pitch, DM, or Loom -> Choose a tone -> Copy the generated script to the clipboard
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the outreach generator -> Change the tone from Data-Driven to Urgency or Soft-Sell -> Review the updated script -> Copy it to the clipboard

features.name: Saved Lead Pipeline
features.description: Lets users save prospect sites locally, organize deal status, and export leads as CSV.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Save the current prospect site -> Open the saved lead pipeline -> Review the saved lead entry
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the saved lead pipeline -> Change a lead's deal status -> Keep the updated pipeline organized
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the saved lead pipeline -> Delete a lead -> See the lead removed from the list
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the saved lead pipeline -> Export the lead list as CSV -> Download the file

features.name: Head-to-Head Competitor Comparison
features.description: Lets users compare a target website against a competitor URL and view win-loss style performance results.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the competitor comparison modal -> Enter a competitor website URL -> Run the head-to-head comparison -> Review comparative metrics and win-loss breakdown

features.name: License Activation and Cloud Sync
features.description: Lets users activate Pro access with a license key or API key and enable cloud vault synchronization.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the activation modal -> Enter a license key or API key -> Activate the license -> See the active subscription badge and success confirmation
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the activation modal -> Enter a valid activation key -> Activate Pro access -> Start cloud vault synchronization

features.name: Agency White-Label Branding Settings
features.description: Allows users to configure agency branding details for white-label use within the extension.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open agency settings -> Enter the agency brand name, auditor name, and website -> Save the settings -> See the branding details retained

routes.description: VitalsSniper Extension main popup dashboard and telemetry interface
